ABACUS.gloss: a tablet placed horizontally on top of the capital of a column as an aid in supporting…
ABACUS.definition: A tablet placed horizontally on top of the capital of a column as an aid in supporting the architrave.

SCUBA.gloss: a device that lets divers breathe under water
SCUBA.definition: A device (trade name Aqua-Lung) that lets divers breathe under water; scuba is an acronym for self-contained underwater breathing apparatus.

CAUSA.gloss: a comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks…
CAUSA.definition: A comprehensive term for any proceeding in a court of law whereby an individual seeks a legal remedy.
CAUSA.example: The family brought suit against the landlord.

BUS.definition: A vehicle carrying many passengers; used for public transport.
BUS.example: He always rode the bus to work.

SUB.example: The young teacher had to substitute for the sick colleague.

CAB.definition: A compartment at the front of a motor vehicle or locomotive where driver sits.
